title.zh: 为指定资源的指定监控项设置多条阈值报警规则
title.en: Create multiple threshold alert rules for a specified metric of a specified resource

descriptions.zh:
本文将提供一个示例，为云服务器ECS `acs_ecs_dashboard`的实例`i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo****`中的监控项`cpu_total`设置阈值报警规则。该报警规则的报警联系组为`ECS_Group`、报警规则名称为`test123`、报警规则ID为`a151cd6023eacee2f0978e03863cc1697c89508****`、Critical级别的统计方法为`Average`、Critical级别的比较符为`GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold`、Critical级别的阈值为`90`和Critical级别的报警重试次数为`3`。
> 2024-08-15 增加Statistics校验，统计值只能填对应指标的Statistics。关于如何获取该参数的取值，请参见[云产品监控项](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cms/support/appendix-1-metrics)。
descriptions.en:
This topic provides an example of how to create a threshold alert rule for the `cpu_total` metric of the Elastic Computing Service (ECS) instance `i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo****` in the `acs_ecs_dashboard` namespace. The alert contact group is set to `ECS_Group`, the alert rule name is set to `test123`, the alert rule ID is set to `a151cd6023eacee2f0978e03863cc1697c89508****`, the statistics method for the Critical level is set to `Average`, the comparison operator for the Critical level is set to `GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold`, the threshold for the Critical level is set to `90`, and the retry count for the Critical level is set to `3`.
> As of August 15, 2024, Statistics validation is added. You can set the statistics value only to the Statistics value that corresponds to the metric. For more information about how to obtain the value of this parameter, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cms/support/appendix-1-metrics).

example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutResourceMetricRules --region cn-hangzhou --Rules.1.RuleId a151cd6023eacee2f0978e03863cc1697c895080000 --Rules.1.Times 3 --Rules.1.EffectiveInterval '00:00-23:59' --Rules.1.EmailSubject ECS_instance_alert --Rules.1.Interval 60 --Rules.1.SendOK true --Rules.1.RuleName test123 --Rules.1.MetricName cpu_total --Rules.1.NoEffectiveInterval '00:00-06:00' --Rules.1.Labels.1.Key tagKey1 --Rules.1.Webhook 'https://alert.aliyun.com.com:8080/callback' --Rules.1.Threshold 90 --Rules.1.Resources 'instanceId_:_i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo0000' --Rules.1.SilenceTime 86400 --Rules.1.Period 60 --Rules.1.ContactGroups ECS_Group --Rules.1.NoDataPolicy KEEP_LAST_STATE --Rules.1.Statistics Average --Rules.1.Namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --Rules.1.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --Rules.1.Labels.1.Value ECS
